dedupe_keys.name: north province new caledonia administrative buildings

description: Province Nord (Service Valorisation de l'Information, Direction des Systèmes d'Information) publishes the administrative buildings of the North Province, produced by the information valorisation service of the province, with label, category, function, type, origin, acquisition date and type, built area, real and estimated area and the building outline. Coverage: the North Province of New Caledonia; 66 buildings, record last modified on 2026-09-02. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the open data portal of New Caledonia (data.gouv.nc). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence Ouverte v2.0; cost: free. Caveats: only 66 buildings, so it covers provincial administrative buildings, not the building stock. Simulation uses: exposure and continuity analyses of provincial government buildings. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
